explanation: The theorem is about `HasWeakFDerivOn` and `HasWeakLineDerivOn`, which are the library's own definitions. A grep of the Mathlib sources for `HasWeakFDeriv`, `HasWeakLineDeriv` and `WeakDeriv` returned no matches, so this Mathlib version has no theory of weak derivatives. The content (building a weak Fréchet derivative from weak line derivatives along the vectors of a basis) therefore lies in the library's own definitions. The proof only uses generic Mathlib facts about bases and sums (`Module.Basis.linearCombination_repr`, `map_sum`).
